headlines.headline: OHIO JUDGE GRANTS INJUNCTION FORCING THE NCAA TO GRANDFATHER 24 MEN'S AND WOMEN'S BASKETBALL PLAYERS INTO FIFTH-YEAR ELIGIBILITY
headlines.detail: A federal judge in Ohio ruled the NCAA's age-based exclusion of 24 class-of-2022 players 'arbitrary and capricious' and granted a preliminary injunction letting them compete this year; the NCAA must post a $200,000 bond as the case proceeds to discovery, with a separate Colorado suit expected to resolve within the week.

headlines.headline: GRIZZLIES SEND JA MORANT TO THE TRAIL BLAZERS FOR JERAMI GRANT AND KRIS MURRAY, COMPLETING MEMPHIS'S TEARDOWN OF ITS FORMER CORE
headlines.detail: Memphis traded two-time All-Star Ja Morant to Portland for Jerami Grant, Kris Murray and $1 million cash, the third and final departure from the Grizzlies' former franchise trio after Desmond Bane and Jaren Jackson Jr. were also moved this offseason.

headlines.headline: DEEBO SAMUEL RETURNS TO THE 49ERS AFTER ONE SEASON IN WASHINGTON AS TRAINING CAMP HOLDOUTS AND EXTENSIONS PILE UP LEAGUE-WIDE
headlines.detail: San Francisco reacquired Deebo Samuel a year after trading him away, New Orleans extended Chris Olave for four years and $132 million, and Tampa Bay's Baker Mayfield aired frustration after the Buccaneers declined to extend him.

headlines.headline: SENATE ADJOURNS WITHOUT VOTING ON THE PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT AS UNC PLACES FOOTBALL GM MICHAEL LOMBARDI ON LEAVE
headlines.detail: The Senate left for recess without scheduling a vote on the Protect College Sports Act, leaving NIL and revenue-sharing rules unresolved, while UNC placed GM Michael Lombardi on paid leave and Indiana's Curt Cignetti continued drawing SEC interest at Big Ten Media Days.
